notes: Job Agent v2.9.11 beta follows a successful real macOS run of v2.9.10: 173 vacancies discovered; 3/3 Jobs.cz applications manually submitted and confirmed (Treasury Data Analyst at EP Commodities, Data Analyst CVM at MONETA Money Bank, and Marketing Data Analyst at Siemens). Adds a 'Требуют внимания' Dashboard filter to quickly find unresolved partially filled applications (such as earlier VIG Re) and sensitive pending manual handoffs (such as Sanofi) without showing submitted or archived vacancies. Cleans a generic employer-link UI label ('Company EP Commodities, a.s.' -> 'EP Commodities, a.s.') without changing structured employer names. 67 offline regression tests passed in GitHub Actions. No changes to automatic applicant submission or scoring.
